conflicts.permit: With your consent, we may access your location.
conflicts.prohibit: We will only access your location while you are using the Application or the Site and provided you have opted in to activate this feature.
conflicts.situation: Accessing location data when a user has consented/opted in, but is not currently using the Application or the Site.
conflicts.reason: One sentence strictly limits access to 'only while you are using the Application or the Site', while the other broadly permits access whenever consent is given.
